name: @shiguang/desktop
description: 拾光 Electron 应用：主进程 + 渲染进程（React UI）

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const path=require('path');const paths=[process.cwd(),path.resolve(process.cwd(),'..'),path.resolve(process.cwd(),'../..')];let v=null;for(const p of paths){try{v=require(require.resolve('electron/package.json',{paths:[p]})).version;break}catch(e){}}if(!v){console.log('[@shiguang/desktop] electron not found, skip native ABI rebuild');process.exit(0)}require('child_process').execSync('electron-rebuild -v '+v+' -f -w better-sqlite3',{stdio:'inherit'})"
